open_points.subject: _validate_initial_allocations
open_points.text: _validate_initial_allocations: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST raise FinancialValidationError for an instruction whose target is the section member of = models.AllocationTargetKind without section_id, one whose target is its other_expenses member carrying a section_id, any other target, and an allocation total that differs from the total_amount of the intake, all before opening any transaction; it MUST then open exactly one transaction, resolve every section target only by calling get_project_section of the project_sections repository of that transaction with the project_id of the intake and the section_id, and close that read transaction by exactly one rollback of that transaction, marking it closed before it raises ExpenseValidationError for a missing or cross-project section, so that rejection keeps the input-rejection answer the legacy BudgetValidationError produced; it MUST NOT call validate_project_section, a PortalStore lookup, or a legacy PortalTransaction project-section method.
open_points.question: The note must name the SECTION member, or the enum surface must define a member named section.

open_points.subject: create_expense_from_recognition
open_points.text: create_expense_from_recognition: [ORCHESTRATION] MUST build exactly one audit intent with the imported build_project_audit_intent from the context, the expense.create member of = models.AuditAction as action, the expense member of = models.AuditEntityKind as entity_kind and the expense_id of the expense of the inserted aggregate as entity_id, and append it via the audit repository of that transaction, then commit exactly once and return the outcome the imported build_expense_operation_outcome builds from the inserted aggregate.
open_points.other_text: - AuditEntityKind enum members: BUDGET_VERSION='budget_version', EXPENSE='expense', EXPENSE_ALLOCATION='expense_allocation', EXPENSE_DOCUMENT='expense_document', PRODUCER_GRANT='producer_grant', PROGRESS_PHOTO='progress_photo', SECTION_PLAN='section_plan', SECTION_PROGRESS='section_progress', SERVICE_CREDENTIAL='service_credential', SERVICE_PRINCIPAL='service_principal', SNAPSHOT_IMPORT='snapshot_import', STAFF_ACCOUNT='staff_account', STAFF_ASSIGNMENT='staff_assignment', STAFF_SESSION='staff_session', VIEWER='viewer', VIEWER_CREDENTIAL='viewer_credential', VIEWER_GRANT='viewer_grant', WORK_PAYMENT='work_payment'
open_points.question: The note must name the EXPENSE member, or the enum surface must define a member named expense.

open_points.subject: _classify_expense_replay
open_points.text: _classify_expense_replay: [BEHAVIOR] MUST return ExpenseOperationOutcome containing the existing aggregate with replayed true only for equal intake_fingerprint and otherwise raise ExpenseConflictError without mutation, the replay identity being recognized_document_id with intake_fingerprint as the content check.
open_points.other_text: Never assign to an attribute of a model value (models are frozen). A record listed in RECORDS BUILT FOR THIS MODULE, new or changed, comes only from its builder: call the builder, never model_copy or a constructor of it. Any other model value: derive a changed value with value.model_copy(update={...}) or construct a new instance.
open_points.question: Either build_expense_operation_outcome must expose a way to request replayed true, or ExpenseOperationOutcome must be exempted so _classify_expense_replay may create or copy it with replayed set to true.

open_points.subject: decode_recognition_publication
open_points.text: decode_recognition_publication: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST refuse with ExpenseValidationError a normalized item whose quantity, unit_price or line_total is not a finite decimal, whose quantity is not greater than zero, or whose unit_price or line_total is below zero, and MUST keep each accepted item amount exactly as supplied, without quantizing it, because item amounts are validated for shape only and are not stored.
open_points.rule: - Inline-данные: таблицы соответствий, allow-lists, пороги, TTL, пути, рейтинги, размеры, словари alias'ов.
open_points.question: The zero amount thresholds must be placed in an imported provider constant and named as that imported constant, rather than written inline in the note.
